text_block_list.text: When I went to the cafeteria to grab lunch...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide, nooo, don't give up~~!!
Eat my lunch and cheer up, c'mon!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... No good!
That will only repeat the same mistake!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide isn't eating her food at allll!
What if something's wrong with her!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No! It was to put more energy into classroom studies,
and I just took in a little too much energy!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, the theory was formulated earlier than planned...
and the surplus calories have accumulated in my body...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all! A diet!
Then you just gotta exercise!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Pushing it that far will lead to overwork.
It could ruin the training schedule we meticulously planned."
choice_data_list: I'll make some adjustments, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
B-But... I can't let my own miscalculation
cause trouble for you...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? Why, why? Giving support like that
is what a "Trainer" is supposed to do, right??

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... that's true.
...I suppose that, too, is part of a Trainer's job."
choice_data_list: Alright, time to get to work!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Thank you.
...I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, me too! We're friends, after all!
Eat my share of food too, and do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Were you even listening to me?

And so, after adjusting the training regimen...
she successfully achieved her ideal weight!
